description: The dependency dashboard is off (owner, 2026-09-10). It is a bot-written issue with no acceptance criteria that never reaches a done state, so it sits in a milestone that can then never report as finished, and it is stale between runs. Turning it off changes nothing about what Renovate watches or raises: the merge requests still arrive. ai/orbit turned it off on 2026-09-08 for the same reason; this matches it.

customManagers.description: live-check.Dockerfile's GO_VERSION ARG isn't a FROM line, so no built-in manager sees it (#1312) -- tracked here as the same golang/docker dep as the Dockerfile and .gitlab-ci.yml images so the packageRule below can group all three. GO_SHA256 on the line below is not templated: a version bump still needs its checksum updated by hand.

actions/setup-go's go-version in .github/workflows/*.yml (#1356), tracked here as the same go dep as go.mod so the go toolchain packageRule below groups it with the rest. The github-actions manager is enabled now (#1324) but its own reading of setup-go's go-version is switched off below, so this one line has one owner.

`go install <module>@vX.Y.Z` in .gitlab-ci.yml (#1321) pins tool versions in shell commands, which no built-in manager reads -- gitlabci only sees `image:` references. Tracked here as plain go modules so Renovate opens an MR whenever govulncheck, go-licenses or any future tool installed this way moves.

packageRules.description: The uses: pins in .github/workflows/*.yml (#1324). Renovate keeps them on a 40-character SHA and rewrites the # vX.Y.Z comment beside it. lint:supply-chain-pins fails until supply-chain/pins-policy.json records the new SHA and comment with a review date, so each bump is read by a human before it merges -- the same step the docker and ci-image bumps already take.
setup-go's go-version is owned by the #1356 regex manager above, grouped as go toolchain; without this the github-actions manager would propose the same bump a second time.
Held below 7 while svelte-check's peer range is ^5 || ^6 -- #286 has the measurement and the trigger

go.mod's go directive, the golang image in Dockerfile and .gitlab-ci.yml, live-check.Dockerfile's GO_VERSION ARG, and (#1356) actions/setup-go's go-version in .github/workflows/*.yml move together, so the Go pins #1312 and #1356 found drifted cannot drift apart again
